question: Which stock Xiaomi UI API provides a page-owned modal confirmation dialog?
prototype_hypothesis: box = lvx_page_msgbox_create(parent, firmware_page); lvx_page_msgbox_set_content(box, layout_type, icon, primary, secondary, button_descriptors, button_count)
callsite_evidence: sub_C4A93A4 is the common mode-0 wrapper around sub_C4A9244 and has approximately 51 direct firmware call sites
Settings confirmation flow at 0x0C53C880 creates the box through sub_C4A93A4, zeroes two 20-byte button descriptors, and calls sub_C4A93FC with layout type 2 and button_count 2
sub_C4A900C advances descriptors by 20 bytes and registers descriptor +0 as an LV_EVENT_CLICKED callback, +4 as button text, and +8 as event user data
Stock callbacks sub_C53D444 and sub_C53D3FC delete the message-box object before applying or cancelling the operation
control_flow_evidence: The common constructor stores the firmware page at box +0x34, saves/replaces the page event callback, and inserts the box into the active message-box list at 0x200CE9F4
The class destructor at sub_C4A92C4 removes the box from the active list and restores the saved page callback/state
Layout type 2 is a proven two-text-button confirmation; type 5 is an icon cancel/confirm layout and is not used for Canopus destructive actions
ownership_analysis: The message box is an LVGL class object owned by the current firmware page. It must be destroyed through lv_obj_del so its class destructor restores page interception. Manager retains static message/button strings and callback records until the modal is dismissed. Page destruction dismisses any active box first.
unsafe_assumptions: The recovered API is exact to firmware 3.101.030 and remains identity-gated
Static analysis establishes the descriptor and callback ABI, but repeated open/cancel/confirm, back gesture, pause/resume and page teardown still require an on-device lifecycle probe
The backend falls back to its existing semantic confirmation page if the native constructor cannot be used
recommended_probe: Open each Manager confirmation, cancel and confirm repeatedly, press system back while modal, leave/re-enter the app, and destroy the detail page while modal. Verify only one callback fires, page input is blocked, and the underlying page remains interactive after dismissal.

artifacts.role: stock two-button Settings confirmation call site
